class.name: NetwSceneConfig
class.brief_description: Makes a node a multiplayer scene.
class.description:
Returned by [method Netw.configure_scene]. Declare it once from the scene root's [method Object._init], the methods can be called in any order. [codeblock] extends Node2D
func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_scene(self).labeled(&"Level1").isolated() [/codeblock] Every entity below the root belongs to the scene through [member NetwEntity.scene], and [member NetwEntity.is_scene] is [code]true[/code] on the root.

method.name: isolated
method.description: Gives this scene its own physics and rendering world on every peer. [codeblock lang=text] Main └ Level1View a StretchViewportContainer └ Level1World a SubViewport └ Level1 your scene [/codeblock] - An absolute path such as [code]/root/Main/Level1[/code] does not reach the scene. Use relative paths or [method Netw.scene]. - [method Node.get_viewport] answers the scene's [SubViewport], not the window. - Only the scene your player is in is drawn and takes input. The others keep running. - Each isolated scene runs its own physics world, which costs CPU every physics tick. Isolate a scene only when it can be loaded next to another.

method.name: labeled
method.description: Names the scene for [method Netw.scene]. Defaults to the root node's name. [method Netw.scene] fails when several live scenes share the label. Use the node returned by [method Netw.spawn] to select an instance.

members.member: The name given to [method labeled], or the root node's name.
